rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) cap of 5%
rules.requirement: The Annual General Adjustment by which a landlord of a fully-covered unit may raise rent each year is set by formula tied to the Consumer Price Index, but can be no more than 5% in any year.
rules.key_value: AGA tied to Consumer Price Index, maximum 5%
rules.coverage_text: Fully-covered rental units under Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: The cap does not prevent a landlord who has banked (unused) AGAs from previous years from implementing a rent increase greater than 5% to raise the rent to the rent ceiling.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.

rules.title: Narrowed exemption for units sharing kitchen or bath with landlord
rules.requirement: A unit where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath with the landlord is exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.coverage_text: Units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord.
rules.exemptions: Exempt only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: Where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord, the unit will be exempt from the Rent Ordinance only if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.

rules.title: Coverage of government-owned or -subsidized units
rules.requirement: Government-owned or -subsidized rental units become fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance; fully covered units have a rent ceiling limiting increases to the Annual General Adjustment, and landlords must register them and pay an annual registration fee.
rules.coverage_text: Government-owned or -subsidized units such as Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8), Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME and other listed subsidies; full or partial coverage depends on unit type.
rules.exemptions: Units with Section 202 or Section 811 subsidies, and Rent Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside or Project-based Section 8 units in projects with mortgages insured or held by HUD, are only partially covered regardless of unit type.
rules.quoted_span: Government-owned or -subsidized rental units become either fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.interaction_text: Whether a unit is fully or partially covered depends on unit type and if Federal law, State law, or administrative regulation exempts the unit from the rent control provisions of Berkeley’s Rent Ordinance.

rules.title: Capital improvement rent increase petitions limited to completed improvements
rules.requirement: Landlords may only petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements, not planned capital improvements.
rules.coverage_text: Landlords petitioning the Rent Board for capital improvement rent increases.
rules.quoted_span: Owners may only petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements, rather than planned capital improvements.

rules.title: Minimum rental debt for nonpayment eviction
rules.requirement: A landlord may evict for nonpayment of rent only if the tenant owes rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the HUD Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size in the Oakland-Fremont metro area for the fiscal year in which rent is demanded.
rules.key_value: Rental debt >= one month of HUD Fair Market Rent (Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR) for a unit of equivalent size
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.

rules.title: No eviction for failing to sign a substantially similar lease
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.

rules.title: Requirements for eviction based on breach of a material lease term
rules.requirement: Material lease terms include only mutually agreed terms; the violation must cause substantial, actual damage to the landlord, the landlord must show the tenant's behavior was unreasonable, and the notice to cease must specify the lease term and describe the violation and harm in enough detail for a reasonable person to understand.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: In any notice terminating a tenancy for a lease breach, the landlord must clearly describe the alleged breach. The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant’s behavior was unreasonable, and may not evict tenants for lease breaches that do not cause the landlord any actual harm.

rules.title: Eviction notice content and filing with the Rent Board
rules.requirement: Any notice terminating a tenancy must state that advice is available from the Rent Board and give its phone number and website address, and the landlord must file copies of termination notices, notices to quit, and summons and complaint with the Rent Board no later than three business days after service on the tenant.
rules.key_value: File with Rent Board within three business days of service
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: Eviction notices must contain certain information directing tenants to the Rent Board, and copies of eviction notices and eviction lawsuits must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days of serving the tenant.

rules.title: Mandatory annual adjustment of owner move-in relocation assistance
rules.requirement: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.coverage_text: Owner move-in evictions requiring relocation assistance payments.
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
